senses.gloss: m. (exercitus, ἐξέρκετον, S.) army. Lam. R. introd. (R. Naḥm.) (ref. to Is. XXIX, 1) קריה … דוד לק׳ שלו the city which David built for his army; Yalk. Is. 302 קיסרקיסון (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:13">Cant. R. to VIII, 13</cite> <he>נטל קצרקטין שלו וכ׳</he> (read: <cite ref="S01855"><he>קְצִרְקְטוֹן</he></cite>) he took his entire army and his servants (cabinet) &c.
